definitions.explanation: Fine powdery substance produced by flowers for plant reproduction. Pollen is a major cause of allergies, especially in spring.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}は{花粉|かふん}がたくさん{飛|と}ぶ。
examples.english: A lot of pollen flies around in spring.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}が{花粉|かふん}を{集|あつ}めている。
{今日|きょう}は{花粉|かふん}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The amount of pollen dispersal is high today.

notes:
{花粉|かふん} refers to pollen.

Common expressions:
- {花粉|かふん}が{飛|と}ぶ (pollen flies/disperses)
- {花粉|かふん}{情報|じょうほう} (pollen forecast)
- {花粉|かふん}の{飛散量|ひさんりょう} (amount of pollen dispersal)
- {花粉|かふん}を{媒介|ばいかい}する (to carry pollen)

Related terms:
- {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever, pollen allergy)
- {杉|すぎ}{花粉|かふん} (cedar pollen - the main allergen in Japan)
- {花粉|かふん}マスク (pollen mask)

Note:
{花粉|かふん} is heavily associated with allergies in Japan. Weather forecasts regularly include pollen counts ({花粉|かふん}{予報|よほう}) during spring, and many Japanese wear masks during pollen season.
